body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure our iduna swagger spec is fully updated wherever it lives.' Two real spec files exist (openapi.go, the live served spec; openapi.yaml, a static Swagger 2.0 copy already flagged in CHANGELOG.md as known-stale/unreconciled) -- both updated with /admin/kanban, /api/v1/kanban/cards[/:id], /portal, /portal/login, and the KanbanCard schema. New regression test (openapi_test.go) asserts the live spec actually contains these. go test ./... green. IDUNA commit 1d3ef33.

⚓ ☃
title: OpenAPI/Swagger spec updated with kanban + dev portal (founder ask)
